{{Quote|My pet razor cat cub, Missy, is gone! She wandered out into the wilderness all alone! Will you please, please, please go find Missy?|[[Brantlee Spondoon]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BS" />}}
'''Missy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|razor cat]] that lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the cub Missy was owned the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] woman named [[Brantlee Spondoon]], the assistant to the [[Diktat]] of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].<ref name="SWG:BS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Missy escaped her mistress and got away into the wilderness all alone. Her desperate mistress soon requested a spacer working for the government to seek for her beloved razor cat. As Spondoon expected, the spacer found Missy along with a dangerous full-grown razor cat. The spacer thus killed the beast and eventually brought back the cub to Brantlee Spondoon.<ref name="SWG:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Missy appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Missy was part of the third quest given by Brantlee Spondoon in the original release of the game.<ref name="SWG:BS" /> This quest was removed from the game with the release of the expansion ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]'', on [[November 1]], [[2005]], since Brantlee Spondoon was included in a new story arc, i.e., the [[Rogue CorSec]] plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref> This questline was later inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]", the main questline in the game,<ref name="SWG:HGtII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Help Get the Informant's Information|Corellia}}</ref> with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref>
